title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Program Credit Balance and Refundable Credit
content:
For a **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** program, the credit balance and the refundable credit on a lender's refund request are defined as follows.

**Credit balance.** The program's credit balance is the lender payments plus the premium credits on the program account, less the premium charges and the refunds already paid, taken over every entry on the account.

**Refundable credit.** The refundable credit is the program's credit balance, never below zero, rounded half to even to the cent as the last step of the figure.

| Entries on the program account | Effect on the credit balance |
|---|---|
| Lender payments | Raise it |
| Premium credits (unearned premium credited on cancellations) | Raise it |
| Premium charges (new placements and renewals) | Lower it |
| Refunds already paid to the lender | Lower it |

Every entry on the account counts, from the program's first entry to the latest, whatever statement month it appears on.

## Worked example (hypothetical account)

| Entry kind | Total over every entry |
|---|---|
| Lender payments | 18,450.00 dollars |
| Premium credits | 2,310.40 dollars |
| Premium charges | 17,980.25 dollars |
| Refunds already paid | 500.00 dollars |

Credit balance: 18,450.00 plus 2,310.40, less 17,980.25, less 500.00, which is 2,280.15 dollars. Refundable credit: 2,280.15 dollars.

Had the charges totalled 21,000.00 dollars instead, the balance would be below zero and the refundable credit would be zero.
